as_told.title: Italian SAR scans of structures beneath pyramid

plain: The claim is that radar scans have found huge built structures deep under the pyramids of Giza in Egypt, laid out like an energy grid. If true, the builders put something engineered far beneath the monuments. The first-hand source is Filippo Biondi, an Italian radar scientist who has been on Michels's show. He used a method called synthetic aperture radar Doppler tomography, a radar technique for imaging what lies below the ground. Biondi says his team counts 'four plus four tubes that are descending underneath,' linking the base of the pyramid 'to something that is located at the bottom,' and he credits colleagues named Corrado Malanga and Armando Mei. Michels, retelling it on several episodes, speaks of eight pillars, coils and columns 'in this shape of an energy grid,' under the chamber of the Khafre pyramid. He says the team also used artificial intelligence and found what looks like 'a small city or energy grid.' Michels also asks why, if the work dates to 2022, it is only coming out now. Joe Rogan says the structures may go 'as deep as 2 km,' and a researcher named Jay Anderson calls the underground signals 'undeniable,' though he does not describe their shape.
